description: Find out how to connect a homeowner with a local company chosen on merit for work in and around their home (an electrician, a plumber, a heating and cooling company, an exterminator, a cleaning company, a painter, a roofer, a moving company, a landscaper, a snow removal company, a window washer, a gutter company, a tree service, a general contractor, a handyman, a fence and deck builder, an appliance repair company, a window and door company, a pool company or a chimney sweep) through À proximité in Vaudreuil-Soulanges, Quebec. You can collect the job and contact details, prepare a request, show the customer a review and submit with their explicit permission. When a suitable professional accepts, they contact the customer directly. Read services, municipalities, availability and the workflow. No booking or callback-time guarantee. This tool only reads public information. Call this first.

locale.description: The customer's language: fr for French, en for English. Use it for the review and the text messages they receive.
